$comment: Card artwork. Illustrator exports land in this directory as SVG.
List every file the design needs HERE, ahead of the file itself arriving:
`pnpm build` fails loudly on a listed file that is missing, rather than
rendering nothing and being noticed by a guest.
After dropping files in, run `pnpm assets:optimize`. It rewrites them
through SVGO at 2dp coordinate precision and stamps `version` below with a
Reference an asset as /card/<file>?v=<version>, never as a bare path: these
are served with immutable cache headers, so a re-export under the same
filename would otherwise never reach anyone who had already loaded it.
